Name: (CP) Not In Here By Yourself - Marriage Dialogue Tweak
Author: LilietBorodina
Description:
Another single line dialogue tweak (see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17842]Haley Reads Magazines[/url] for my first mod﻿). The brief says it all.

Update on 31.08.2023: Added another line!

Update on 21.04.2024: Added another line and converted to i18!

[spoiler]
Original dialogue:
[quote]Don't worry about me... I know you've got a lot of responsibilities outside of the house. I'm fine in here by myself!

Hi, honey. I'm so glad you're home. I was starting to get kind of lonely.

Winter's just around the corner. We need to double check the heating system, turn off the valves, and check all the insulation in the house. Don't worry, I'll take care of it all.[/quote]
New dialogue:
[quote]Don't worry about me... I know you've got a lot of responsibilities outside of the house. We'll be fine in here together!

Hi, honey. I'm so glad you're home. It's just not the same without you with us.

Winter's just around the corner. We need to double check the heating system, turn off the valves, and check all the insulation in the house. Don't worry, we'll take care of it all.[/quote]
[/spoiler]

Comes with Russian and Ukrainian translation built-in!

Recommended (by me) with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]Polyamory Sweet [/url]mod (or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url] mod for 1.5), but it is not required. Compatible with anything that doesn't edit the same line of dialogue; if something does, whichever mod loads last will get the last word.

There will be updates if I encounter any more vanilla dialogue that sounds odd with a poly household. (And I take suggestions!)

---

Manifest.Name: (CP) Not In Here By Yourself
Manifest.Description: If you have multiple spouses, the 'I'll be fine in here by myself' line looks a little strange. Also potentially applicable to your pet, your kids, Abigail's guinea pig hamster, fish tanks, potted plants, pet rocks, etc.
Manifest.Author: Liliet
